name: Ind AS Reporting Format
description: Chart of accounts laid out to the Schedule III / Ind AS balance sheet and statement of profit and loss captions, with positional numeric codes. A code carries its own position in the hierarchy: head NHH00, group NHHGG, sub-group NHHGGSS and ledger NHHGGSSLL, where N is the nature (1 Asset, 2 Liability, 3 Equity, 4 Income, 5 Expense). Head codes always end in 00, so a head can never collide with a group.

ledgers.name: Input GST Receivable
ledgers.description: Recoverable input tax. Held as a current asset rather than netted into the tax liability head, so the balance sheet does not present a receivable as a negative liability.
